name: io.github.crunchtools/pcloud
description: Secure MCP server for pCloud cloud storage

environmentVariables.name: PCLOUD_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: pCloud application client id. With PCLOUD_CLIENT_SECRET, run `mcp-pcloud-crunchtools login` once to authorize.

environmentVariables.name: PCLOUD_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: pCloud application client secret, paired with PCLOUD_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.name: PCLOUD_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: pCloud OAuth access token supplied directly, for containers and CI

environmentVariables.name: PCLOUD_TOKEN_STORE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Where the token obtained by `login` is cached (default: ~/.config/mcp-pcloud/tokens.json)

environmentVariables.name: PCLOUD_API_HOST
environmentVariables.description: api.pcloud.com or eapi.pcloud.com; normally discovered during login
